 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE SATYAVRAT VERMA  ORAL ORDER 5 12-02-2024 1.
Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned A.P.P. for the State along with learned counsel for the O.P. No. 2.
2. The petitioner apprehends his arrest in a case registered for the offences punishable under Section 498A of the Indian Penal Code and Section 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act.

3. The learned counsel for the petitioner and the learned counsel for the O.P. No. 2 submits that the mediation is successful and the dispute in between the petitioner and the O.P. No. 2 has been resolved, as such, it is submitted by the learned counsel for the O.P. No. 2 that O.P. No. 2 does not have any objection in the event if the present anticipatory bail application Patna High Court CR.
MISC. No.4165 of 2023(5) dt.12-02-2024 is allowed.

4. Considering the submissions made by the learned counsel appearing on behalf of the O.P. No. 2,
